card.name: Early pieces of therapy and medical terms
card.fires_on: The first pieces of long medical words such as therapy, therapeutic, epilepsy, pancreatitis, hypotension and aminotransferases, just before the word is completed.

modes.label: Therapy words
modes.description: Start of therapy or therapeutic split into pieces, often in headings.

modes.label: Other long clinical terms
modes.description: Partway through words like epilepsy, pancreatitis, hypotension, aminotransferases.

card.writes: Suggests the word will continue with endings like -atic, -atur or -ermal, though the effect is weak and mixed.
card.plain: It fires when a long medical word, especially therapy, has only just begun and the rest is still to come.
